command: vite build; CHANGEDESK_ALL_IN=1 vite build; node zlib.gzipSync per emitted JS/CSS file
notes: React and react-dom are peer dependencies in the accepted SDK build.
CSS code splitting keeps panel styling out of the launcher path.
The all-in build is reported separately and is not the distributed peer-externalized artifact.
Source maps and declarations are excluded from runtime bundle totals.
